subject: Post-demo: Security & Privacy follow-up (SOC 2, Vendor Questionnaire, Telemetry)

Subject: Post-demo: Security & Privacy follow-up (SOC 2, Vendor Questionnaire, Telemetry)

Hi Timothy —

Thanks again for taking the demo today — really enjoyed the conversation and learning more about how Acme Health is thinking about near-real-time clinical summarization. As promised, a quick recap and next steps focused on security/compliance and telemetry questions you raised.

Recap:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II controls for our platform in 2025; we maintain an annual audit and can provide the latest summary and scope (see attached Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf).
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support data residency and private deployment options. For HIPAA-covered workflows, we offer Dedicated and Private deployments and can sign a BAA for eligible plans.
- Vendor questionnaire: happy to start the vendor security questionnaire — we typically use an XLSX with responses and supporting artifacts (system diagrams, policies).
- Telemetry & cookies: our console collects minimal telemetry for product functionality (error/usage logs, opt-in metrics). We do not persist PII in telemetry; we can provide more detail on storage, retention, and opt-out.

Proposed next steps:
1) I attached a short SOC 2 summary and a vendor-security-questionnaire template. Can you confirm the contact for your security team (name/email) so we can ping them directly?
2) Neha will own the questionnaire response and loop in Dev (our infra/security lead) for technical details and the data-flow diagram.
3) If you need a BAA, we can route that via DocuSign — I included a link below; let me know and I'll initiate.

Would early next week work for a 30-min follow-up with your security/contact?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf
From: Timothy Blake <timothy.blake@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jill Ramos <jill.ramos@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:18:42 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Security & Privacy follow-up (SOC 2, Vendor Questionnaire, Telemetry)

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick recap and the SOC 2 summary — helpful. A few clarifying questions before we schedule:

1) SOC 2 scope: does the report include our planned ingestion path (API gateway -> private VPC -> model inference) or is it limited to hosted-only? We need to confirm the scope covers the control environment for private deployments.
2) Telemetry: what exact fields are collected by the console/docs site? Specifically, do any telemetry logs include customer-controlled text (even transiently) or identifiers that could be considered PHI?
3) Vendor questionnaire: please send the XLSX and any supporting diagram. Our security team also expects an estimated turnaround time for a full questionnaire (we typically require completion within 7 business days).
4) BAA: We will need a BAA for production PHI use; can you confirm how Redwood handles key management and whether the private deployment option supports customer-managed KMS?

If you can address these in writing and share the checklist, we can determine if a call is needed. Thanks —

Timothy Blake
Director, IT Security | Acme Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Timothy Blake <timothy.blake@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Security & Privacy follow-up (SOC 2, Vendor Questionnaire, Telemetry)

Timothy —

Thanks for the clarity. Answers below and attachments included. Short answers first, details and links after.

1) SOC 2 scope: Our SOC 2 Type II report covers the Redwood control environment for both hosted and Private deployments that are managed by Redwood. For on-prem air-gapped installs we provide a controls mapping; for Private (VPC) deployments within customer cloud accounts, our audit scope includes the Redwood-managed control plane and the pieces of the stack we operate. See the attached SOC2 summary for high-level scope.

2) Telemetry: The console and docs site collect product telemetry for usage analytics and error reporting. We do NOT store user-supplied document text or PHI in telemetry. Telemetry fields typically include: event type, timestamp, feature flags, anonymized client id, latency metrics, and SDK version. We redacted an example telemetry schema in the attached data-flow diagram. Retention is configurable; default is 90 days.

3) Vendor questionnaire & artifacts: Attached is vendor-security-questionnaire.xlsx and redwood-data-flow-diagram.png. Neha will coordinate the questionnaire and can turn around answers within 5 business days once we have the full list of questions and any clarifying asks.

4) BAA & KMS: We do offer BAAs for customers with PHI workflows. Private/Dedicated deployments support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS). Dev (cc'd) can provide the KMS integration doc and confirm key lifecycle practices.

Proposed next step: Neha will own the questionnaire and Dev can schedule a technical 30-min call to walk your security team through architecture and key management. If that works, please share your security contact details and available times.

Links: SOC2 overview: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/soc2
BAA/Docusign: https://docusign.com/BAA-acme

Best,
Marissa
